title.narrative: Kvinna till Kvinna SPACE programme 2024-2025, Civil Society Strategy - Kvinna till Kvinna 2024 Strategy Civil Society

description.narrative: Kvinna till Kvinna (KtK) arbetar för jämställdhet och kvinnors deltagande i fredsprocesser i länder drabbade av krig och konflikt i linje med FN:s säkerhetsrådsresolution 1325 (och de efterföljande resolutionerna om kvinnor, fred och säkerhetsagendan). KtK:s ansökan till Sida om stöd för programmet "Strengthening Peacebuilders' Actions for Community Engagement -¬ SPACE" gällde åren 2024-2028. Detta avtal har tecknats på elva månader p g a regeringens styrning till Sida i regleringsbrevet. Det har sedan förlängts t o m 30 september 2025 i enlighet med regeringens beslut om att möjliggöra en övergångsfas. Inom SPACE-programmet arbetar KtK med fyra tematiska förändringsområden: 1) feministisk fred, 2) politiska och ekonomiska rättigheter, 3) könsrelaterat våld (GBV) och sexuell, reproduktiv hälsa och rättigheter (SRHR), och 4) feministiska rörelser. KtK stödjer dryga 60-talet lokala partnerorganisationer inom ramen för SPACE-programmet i KtK:s fyra geografiska verksamhetsregioner: Afrika söder om Sahara, Södra Kaukasus och Ukraina, Västra Balkan samt Mellanöstern och Nordafrika (MENA). Programmet bedöms som relevant för CSO-strategin 2024 och dess målområden 1) Stärkt kapacitet hos civilsamhället i utvecklingsländer; och 2) Förutsättningar för civilsamhällesaktörer i utvecklingsländer att verka.

The Kvinna till Kvinna Foundation (KtK) works for gender equality and women's participation in peace processes in countries affected by war and conflict in line with UN Security Council Resolution 1325 (and the subsequent resolutions on the Women, Peace and Security Agenda). KtK's application to Sida for support for the program "Strengthening Peacebuilders' Actions for Community Engagement -¬ SPACE" was for the years 2024-2028. This agreement has been signed for eleven months due to the government's steering to Sida in the appropriation direction. It has then been extended until September 30th 2025 following the government decision on possible extension in the new CSO strategy for 2025-2029. Within the SPACE program, KtK works with four thematic areas of change: 1) feminist peace, 2) political and economic rights, 3) gender-based violence (GBV) and sexual, reproductive health and rights (SRHR), and 4) feminist movements. KtK supports more than 60 local partner organizations within the framework of the SPACE program in KtK's four geographical operating regions: Sub-Saharan Africa, South Caucasus and Ukraine, Western Balkans, and Middle East and North Africa (MENA). The programme is assessed as relevant to the CSO Strategy 2024 and its target areas: 1) Strengthening the capacity of civil society in developing countries; and 2) Conditions for civil society actors in developing countries to operate.

Sida följer upp insatsen på nivån "CIVSAM Global Outcomes", till vilken resultat från landprogram och den regionala nivån förväntas bidra. "CIVSAM Global Outcomes" har följande 12 mål (WCSO's står för "Women Civil Society Organizations"). Notera att bedömningen är gjord på ett femårigt resultatramverk. Inför ett 11 månaders avtal har KtK justerat målen något, vilket visar att KtK arbetar mot de femåriga målen, men kommer att kunna bidra till dem i mindre utsträckning:
1. Feministisk fred
1a) Women's peacebuilding efforts have been successfully implemented, sustained, and have contributed to gendered conflict transformation.
(2024: Women's peacebuilding efforts have been strengthened)
1b) Women have documented and spread awareness about injustices and WCSO's have contributed to inclusive formal and informal justice frameworks.
(2024: Women have documented and spread awareness about injustices and WCSOs have contributed to build more inclusive formal and informal justice frameworks.)
1c) WCSO's advocacy related to the WPS agenda has influenced policy and practice.
(2024: WCSO's has conducted advocacy endeavours related to the WPS agenda to influence policy and practice.)
2. Politiska och ekonomiska rättigheter
2a) Exclusionary structures and practices related to decision making on local, national and international levels have been challenged by WCSO's.
(2024: as above)
2b) Women maintain and/or increase their political participation in local and national governance structures.
(2024: Women have maintained and/or increased their political participation in elections as well as in local and national governance structures.)
2c) WCSO's and feminist initiatives have countered barriers to economic rights and justice, improving access to and control over resources.
(2024: WCSOs and feminist initiatives have advocated to remove barriers to economic rights and justice, to improve access to and control over resources.)
3. GBV och SRHR
3a) WCSO's advocacy lead to the improvement of legal frameworks, policies, and protection mechanisms of GBV survivors and SRHR right holders are improved and easily accessible.
(2024: WCSOs advocated for the improvement of legal frameworks, policies, and protection mechanisms of GBV survivors and SRHR.)
3b) Women's and girls' access to safe healthcare services and justice at all levels has improved and access has increased.
(2024: Women's and girls' access to healthcare services has increased and justice at all levels has improved.)
3c) CSO's have challenged and/or contributed to the change of harmful social norms and attitudes related to gender, GBV and SRHR.
(2024: as above)
4. Feministiska rörelser
4a) Dialogue and trust have increased between different women's rights groups bridging divisions and discrimination such as transphobia, age, disability, class, conflict narratives and other divides, contributing to a stronger and more inclusive womens movement.
(2024: as above)
4b) WCSO's joint actions have increased and have been acknowledged on local, national, and international levels.
(2024: WCSOs joint actions have increased)
4c) WCSO's have strengthened organisational capacity, improved security management and increased access to predictable, flexible and long-term financial support.
(2024: WCSOs have strengthened organisational capacity, improved security management and have fundraised and advocated for increased access to predictable, flexible and long-term financial support.)
Utöver de målnivåer som ingår i avtalet med Sida, har resultatramverket även mål på landnivå.

16.7 - Ensure responsive, inclusive, participatory and representative decision-making at all levels.

5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.2 - Avskaffa alla former av våld mot alla kvinnor och flickor i det offentliga och privata rummet, inklusive människohandel, sexuellt utnyttjande och andra typer av exploatering.
5.2 - Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.

5.6 - Ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights as agreed in accordance with the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development and the Beijing Platform for Action and the outcome documents of their review conferences.

5.6 - Säkerställa allmän tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsa och reproduktiva rättigheter i enlighet med överenskommelserna i handlingsprogrammet från den internationella konferensen om befolkning och utveckling, Pekingplattformen samt slutdokumenten från respektive översynskonferenser.
